446827.overview: During a trip to Egypt, a strange old man who claims to be the descendant of the last pharaohs gives you an ancient document covered with incomprehensible signs before he dies. Fortunately one of your traveling companions, an eminent Egyptologist, deciphers these hieroglyphs for you; here is the translation he gives you: ALL ANKH AMON, IN HIS INFINITE POWER, HIDDEN HIS TREASURE IN THE SECRET CHAMBER. THE PASSAGE IS FOUND IN THE SACRED SPINX INSIDE THE GREAT PYRAMID. ONLY THE INITIATE WHO KNOWS THE SECRET MESSAGE WILL BE ABLE TO ACCESS IT.
